categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of scroll compressors. The main product lines include four application categories: heat pump applications (heating and hot water), commercial air conditioning applications, refrigeration and freezing applications, and electric-driven vehicle applications. The company also provides technical services and after-sales support for these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in scroll compressor technology, which is the latest generation of compression technology. The company has mastered core scroll compressor technology and was the first domestic company to achieve mass production of commercial scroll refrigeration compressors in China in June 2013. The company employs a 'make-to-order' production model with flexible manufacturing capabilities to meet diverse customer needs. Manufacturing processes include precision machining, assembly, and quality control with full lifecycle traceability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves customers in multiple downstream industries including commercial buildings, public services, medical and health facilities, rail transit, agricultural storage, and cold chain logistics. Primary customer types include air conditioning manufacturers, refrigeration equipment manufacturers, heat pump system integrators, and commercial refrigeration equipment providers. The company has a diversified customer base with the top five customers accounting for approximately 29.81% of annual sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changshu, Jiangsu Province. Domestic sales account for 69.41% of revenue while international sales represent 30.59%. The company has established overseas subsidiaries including operations in Thailand, the United States, and Singapore to support international market expansion and establish overseas production bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures scroll compressors as core components for downstream refrigeration and heating equipment manufacturers. The company sources raw materials including motors, scroll casting blanks, shells, crankshafts, and lubricating oil from multiple suppliers, and sells finished compressors to equipment manufacturers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) deepening domestic substitution of imported compressors; (2) continuous innovation and R&D investment with focus on new product platforms and optimization of existing products; (3) expanding application fields including new energy vehicles, energy storage temperature control, and rail transit; (4) establishing overseas production bases to enhance global competitiveness; (5) digital and intelligent manufacturing transformation. R&D investment in 2024 reached 48.61 million yuan, representing 8.15% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of scroll compressors. The sales model combines both distribution (54.89% of revenue) and direct sales (45.11% of revenue). Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products, which occurs at delivery for domestic sales and upon issuance of bills of lading for export sales. The company maintains a 'sales-driven production' model with some inventory of standard products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international brands including Emerson, Copeland, Daikin, and other foreign manufacturers that have established production facilities in China. The company is positioned as the leading domestic independent supplier of scroll compressors with the largest cumulative shipment volume among Chinese manufacturers. The company differentiates through cost advantages, rapid response capabilities, superior service, and continuous technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 596.73 million yuan, representing 7.52% growth from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 74.17 million yuan in 2024, down 15.14% from 2023 due to changes in sales mix and increased R&D investment. The company has total assets of 1.21 billion yuan and shareholders' equity of 1.03 billion yuan as of December 31, 2024. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in July 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes energy efficiency, high reliability, and low noise in its scroll compressor products. Key differentiators include: (1) advanced technology with superior performance in efficiency, operating range, and reliability; (2) flexible manufacturing capabilities enabling rapid customization for diverse customer needs; (3) comprehensive quality control from design through after-sales service; (4) responsive technical support and integrated solutions; (5) cost-effective pricing compared to international brands; (6) proven track record with 10+ years of market presence and strong customer recognition.
